links.outcome: Expert versus non-expert ratings of ChatGPT recommendation quality
links.effect: Experts scored ChatGPT responses lower than non-experts: 2 (1-2) vs. 2 (2-3), p<0.001.
links.quote: Experts scored the quality of ChatGPT responses lower than non-experts (2 (1-2) vs. 2 (2-3), p<0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's responses to hernia repair questions by expert and non-expert surgeons; evaluates baseline LLM capability without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
